messages.subject: creating a function with inputs and reactive
parts:
I have the following code below which works and produces the desired result.  However, it needs to be used five more times.  I would like to create a function using the input$ and reactive elements but I am not sure exactly how to go about creating the function.

 Price <- PriceTypes(Price = input$price)
        MBS <- MBS.Id()
        TS <- isolate(TS())
        Mtg_Rate <- MtgRate()
        Burnout <- BurnOut(MBS)
        ModelType <- ModelTune(bond.id = MBS)
        Prepayment <- PrepaymentModel(bond.id = MBS, 
                                      TermStructure = TS,
                                      MortgageRate = Mtg_Rate,
                                      ModelTune = ModelType,
                                      Burnout = Burnout,
                                      PrepaymentAssumption = "CPR",
                                      CPR = as.numeric(input$scenario_1))
        
        MBSCashFlow <- MortgageCashFlow(bond.id = MBS,
                                        original.bal = OriginalBal(MBS),
                                        settlement.date = input$settledt,
                                        price = input$price,
                                        PrepaymentAssumption = Prepayment)
        
        Proceeds <- (PriceBasis(Price) * OriginalBal(MBS) * MBSFactor(MBS)) + 
          Accrued(MBSCashFlow)
        
        Spreads <- CurveSpreads(rates.data = RatesData(), 
                                CashFlow = MBSCashFlow,
                                TermStructure = TS, 
                                proceeds = Proceeds)
